claim_boundary: Selection of a more reliable existing teacher on the known synthetic Sequence303 TRAIN fixture, followed by original aggregate validation qualification. Reused campaign validation; no test-based selection, new teacher optimization, learner result, native-base consolidation, broad transfer or SDFT/SDPO reproduction.
coverage_interpretation: For this positionwise synthetic mapping, perfect accuracy in all72cells is equivalent to perfect strict whole-answer accuracy over the fullTRAIN pool. The cell table diagnoses reliability; it is not a new loss or evidence that stratification adds predictive power beyond perfect fullTRAIN accuracy. Only128inputs per task are covered, not all512 possible inputs.
failure_action: On missing cell, any TRAIN binding error, broken provenance or failed selected validation qualification, preserve evidence and perform zero learner updates. A new teacher training intervention would require a separate protocol; none is included initially.
history_contract: Reverify the valid original32aggregate qualification, original384-update training receipt, original95%-probe selection32, all saved checkpoint/probe/optimizer hashes and the original rejected raw-generation diagnosis. Their files and selection decisions are unchanged. Newcoverage receipts have their own source/protocol identity.
learner_boundary: A separate coverage_learner entrypoint must call coverage_teacher.verify_qualified before constructing learner targets or loading a learner. It can reuse frozen cache/target/loss/train_arm primitives from generation_consolidation, but must own its new receipt validation and source manifest. No replacement of old validators, forged legacy receipt, runtime monkeypatch or prior qualification mutation.

observed_training_defect.interpretation: All8 teacher TRAIN errors occur in this cell, but7other cases are correct. A partial, context-dependent reliability failure; not a wholly absent primitive. The original aggregate qualification remains valid under its own contract.

qualification_contract: In a new process load only the selected existing checkpoint. Retain the frozen original generation_gate: each task on TRAIN and validation requires>=.9 strict whole-answer/nativeEOS and original four-choice accuracy. TRAIN generations come from the bound selection panel; score TRAIN choices and validation generations/choices with exact checkpoint tensors. Validation binding cells are reported diagnostically only and do not change selection. Do not evaluate TEST or unused-input panels here.
selection_contract: Screen all384TRAIN rows at each preexisting checkpoint32,128,384. The32 fullTRAIN generations are reused byte-for-byte from its verified original qualification. Evaluate128/384 with unchanged raw prompt, strict body/nativeEOS, full-vocabulary greedy generation and frozen FP32 base/adapter. Every task x literal position x corresponding inputdigit cell must be nonempty and100%correct with exact format/nativeEOS. Choose earliest passing checkpoint only after all three TRAIN panels; if none pass reject. No new teacher updates, no validation/test predictions during selection, no fallback to another checkpoint after validation failure.
